slot.brief: Sentence with a time clause requiring the correct tense (e.g., 'By the time we arrived, the show ___ started' - present perfect vs past perfect choice).

stem: The curator will unlock the gallery after the security guards ............ their inspection of the premises.

verdicts.working: In a future time clause introduced by “after,” use the present simple: “after the security guards complete.”

working:
In a future time clause introduced by “after,” use the simple present for the future action: “after the guards complete.” “Will complete” incorrectly uses the future in the time clause; “completed” and “had completed” do not fit the future main clause.

Independent check: In a future time clause introduced by “after,” use the present simple: “after the security guards complete.”
solution: In a future time clause introduced by “after,” use the simple present tense. Thus, “after the security guards complete their inspection” is correct.
